P.name: Voracity
P.title: Template:Data Katarina/Voracity
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Voracity|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Katarina
|skill        = I
|icon         = Voracity.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} Scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}} within a short time of damaging them {{sti|cdr|reduces}} the '''current''' cooldowns of {{cis|Katarina}} {{tip|abilities}}.
|blurb2     = {{sbc|Innate - Sinister Steel:}} Whenever '''Katarina''' retrieves a {{as|Dagger|buzzword}}, she uses it to slash around herself, dealing {{as|magic damage}} and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects, as well as {{sti|cdr|reducing}}  ''{{ai|Shunpo|Katarina|Shunpo's}}'' '''total''' cooldown.
|blurb3      = A {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} will disappear after being on the ground for a few seconds.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} Scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}} within 3 seconds of damaging them will reduce the {{sti|'''current''' cooldowns}} of '''Katarina's''' {{tip|abilities}} by 15 seconds.
|icon2        = Sinister Steel.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Innate - Sinister Steel:}} Whenever '''Katarina''' retrieves a {{as|Dagger|buzzword}}, she slashes around herself to deal {{pplevel|68;72;77;82;89;96;103;112;121;131;142;154;166;180;194;208;224;240;257;275<!--|formula=???-->|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ {{pp|key=%|70 to 100 for 4|1 to 16}} AP)}} {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects to enemy champions hit, and reduce ''{{ai|Shunpo|Katarina|Shunpo's}}'' '''current''' cooldown by {{pp|key=%|78 to 96 for 4|1 to 16}} of its '''total''' cooldown.
|description4 = {{as|Daggers|buzzword}} grant {{tip|sight}} of their radius and will disappear after being on the ground for 4 seconds.
|effect radius= {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|340|Spin damage radius, around Katarina}}
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Enemies, Self
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = Area of effect
|parry        = special
|projectile   = 
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
* ''Voracity's'' cooldown reduction will still take effect even after '''Katarina''' dies.
* The {{as|Dagger's|buzzword}} area of effect indicator is displayed even before it lands, although '''Katarina''' may not slash until it has. This can be targeted by {{ai|Shunpo|Katarina}}.
* {{as|Daggers|buzzword}} will still deal damage but not apply on-hit effects if {{tip|dodged}}. They cannot be {{tip|block|blocked}} nor can they be missed while '''Katarina''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
* Single-use on-hit effects, such as {{tip|Spellblade}}, will apply to the closest target to '''Katarina''' when she uses a {{as|Dagger|buzzword}}.
}}

E.name: Shunpo
E.title: Template:Data Katarina/Shunpo
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Shunpo|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Katarina
|skill        = E
|icon         = Shunpo.png
|blurb        =  {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Katarina}} {{tip|blinks}} to the target location around the target unit or {{as|Dagger|buzzword}}, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to the nearest enemy and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Katarina''' {{tip|blinks}} to a target location near the unit or {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} closest to the cursor, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to the nearest enemy in range and applying {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
|description2 = '''Katarina''' prioritizes blinking to the location near {{as|Daggers|buzzword}}, then enemy champions, then enemy non-champions, and then any other unit.
|description3 = ''Shunpo {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Katarina's''' basic attack timer.
|leveling     = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|20 to 60}} {{as|(+ 40% AD)}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|12 to 8}}
|target range = {{dv|{{tt|725|Standard cast range}}|{{tt|775|Cast range on daggers}}}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.15}}
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = Single target
|projectile   = 
|parry        = special
|callforhelp  = True
|grounded     = True
|outofrange   = walk to location
|notes        = 
* ''Shunpo's'' effects occur before the cast time.
* ''Shunpo'' does not reset '''Katarina's''' basic attack timer if it killed the target.{{bug|2}}
* ''Shunpo'' can be used on any unit except {{tip|structures}} and {{tip|wards}}.
* ''Shunpo'' can be cast on {{as|Daggers|buzzword}} that haven't landed yet.
* ''Shunpo'' prioritizes damaging enemy champions within range at the targeted location.
* After the cast time, '''Katarina''' will attempt to move towards the closest enemy in {{tip|acquisition radius|acquisition range}} and basic attack them, prioritizing champions, unless an attack command was already active on another target in range or any attack command was applied during the cast time. Movement commands applied during cast time will override the automatic attack, but they may not override an already active manually applied attack command. If no enemy is in range, pre-cast commands will remain active, and attack commands applied during the cast time will be ignored {{bug|2}}.
** If a {{as|Dagger|buzzword}} is picked during the cast time, pre-cast commands will be cancelled, even if no enemy is nearby. And if an enemy is nearby, '''Katarina''' may or may not start an automatic attack {{bug|2}}.
* If the target is very close to a wall and '''Katarina''' targets ''Shunpo'' behind the target, she can blink over the wall.
* ''Shunpo'' will still deal damage but not apply on-hit effects if {{tip|dodged}}. It cannot be {{tip|block|blocked}} nor can it be missed while '''Katarina''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
* ''Shunpo'' does not require the enemy to be within targeting range to damage them. It only requires them to be within the max range around a unit that ''Shunpo'' allows them to blink to.
{{ct|cast}}
}}
